authoringRule: Start from the full Director View, use exact current IDs, and inspect actual pageImageUrl pixels before visual claims, asset selection or storyboarding.
animationRule: Use exact AnimationClip IDs with one representative image per animation family. Do not require every frame.
audioRule: Audio is a first-class non-visual Director input and must not be counted as a visual gap.
prefabRule: Prefab internals are not authoring vocabulary. Only safe CanonicalActor or PreviewSafeVisualComposite projections may be selected; gameplay scripts, colliders and physics remain hidden.
deboraRule: Debora opens deboraPageUrl, presses COPY FOR CHAT, pastes the message, and describes the cutscene. Her ChatGPT reads CURRENT itself.
fallbackRule: If direct Pages access genuinely fails, use fallbackDirectorPackUrl. Never mix transactions or manually pair older packages.
